floor_history.headline: _exeque written in pure C for the first time (was INCLUDE_ASM, floor 187) using the already-merged GpuQueueItem struct; found+fixed a genuine missing extern (D_8009BF84) that was silently miscompiled;
Structural session dropped _exeque from floor 15 to 12: pre-computing a pointer to D_8009BE7C closed the final-callback block byte-exact; the triple-store residual survives two more reordering probes

frontier.hypothesis: The triple-store block's residual is a GCC 2.7.2 sched.c rank_for_schedule dependency-class tie (sched-rank-class-tie-wall shape) between the field-store chain and the idx-increment/loop-condition reloads, not fixable by statement reordering.
frontier.next_probe: Read tmp/grind/_exeque/dumps/display.sched around the basic-block-11 region (insns 103-222, already dumped this session at hash matching the H5a+H5b chassis) for the exact tie, or run a directed permuter scoped to just this ~16-instruction region (much cheaper now that the base floor is 12, not 15).

frontier.hypothesis: An IRQ-callback-installed function's own single-read test-and-clear of a flag it owns qualifies as a fourth catalogued use-site shape under legitimate-volatile-interrupt-touched, which would close 2 more instructions (floor 12 -> 10) with zero further search.
